test.title: Typical mistakes for each essay type

name.en: Typical mistakes for each essay type
Typical mistakes for each essay type

document.title: Typical mistakes for each essay type

why.en: The introduction should not copy the task: paraphrase it.
why.kk: Кіріспе тапсырманы көшірмейді: басқаша айтыңыз.
why.ru: Вступление не копирует задание: перефразируйте.

options: Many people believe that remote work benefits both employees and companies.
Some people think that a growing number of people now work from home for at least part of the week.

why.en: The conclusion needs a clear answer to the question.
why.kk: Қорытындыда сұраққа анық жауап керек.
why.ru: В заключении нужен ясный ответ на вопрос.

options: In conclusion, I believe the benefits of a four-day week outweigh its drawbacks.
In conclusion, there are good and bad sides, and everyone should decide for themselves.

why.en: An example should be specific, not a general claim.
why.kk: Мысал нақты болуы керек, жалпы тұжырым емес.
why.ru: Пример должен быть конкретным, а не общим утверждением.

options: For example, in Japan many companies now let staff work from home two days a week.
For example, everybody knows that working from home is good.

why.en: Informal But / bad things → However / drawbacks.
why.kk: Ауызекі But / bad things → However / drawbacks.
why.ru: Разговорные But / bad things → However / drawbacks.

options: However, this approach has several drawbacks.
But this approach has some bad things.

why.en: because + clause; because of + noun.
why.kk: because + сөйлем; because of + зат есім.
why.ru: because + предложение; because of + существительное.

options: This is mainly because cars produce harmful exhaust fumes.
This is because of cars are bad.

why.en: A while-clause cannot stand alone as a sentence.
why.kk: While бөлігі жеке сөйлем бола алмайды.
why.ru: While-часть не может быть отдельным предложением.

options: Some argue that tourism damages fragile areas, while others believe it brings money.
Some argue that tourism damages fragile areas. While others believe it brings money.

why.en: A solution should be realistic and specific.
why.kk: Шешім шынайы әрі нақты болуы керек.
why.ru: Решение должно быть реалистичным и конкретным.

options: One solution would be to tax excessive packaging.
The solution is that people must stop using all plastic immediately.

why.en: I agree (no am).
why.kk: I agree (am-сыз).
why.ru: I agree (без am).

options: In my view, governments should fund both the arts and essential services.
I am agree that governments should fund the arts.

why.en: Avoid extreme generalisations: use may, often, many.
why.kk: Шектен тыс жалпылаудан аулақ болыңыз: may, often, many.
why.ru: Избегайте крайних обобщений: may, often, many.

options: Children who own smartphones may spend less time outdoors.
All children who own smartphones never go outside.

why.en: Sequencing linkers should not repeat.
why.kk: Реттік байланыстырушылар қайталанбайды.
why.ru: Порядковые связки не повторяются.

options: Firstly, … Secondly, … Finally, …
Firstly, … Firstly, … Firstly, …

why.en: “To what extent” requires an answer — a degree of agreement. Without a position Task Response cannot go above 5.
why.kk: «To what extent» жауапты — келісу дәрежесін талап етеді. Ұстанымсыз Task Response 5-тен аспайды.
why.ru: «To what extent» требует ответа — степени согласия. Без позиции Task Response не выше 5.

options: I strongly agree that advertising aimed at young children should be banned.
There are many advantages and disadvantages of advertising to children, and people have different opinions.

why.en: The position in the introduction and the conclusion must match. A concession belongs in the body, not in the conclusion.
why.kk: Кіріспедегі және қорытындыдағы ұстаным бірдей. Жол беру — негізгі бөлікте, қорытындыда емес.
why.ru: Позиция во вступлении и в выводе совпадает. Уступка — в основной части, не в выводе.

options: In conclusion, advertising should not be allowed to target young children.
In conclusion, advertising is also useful for children, so it should not be banned.

why.en: A claim without explanation or example is a list, not an argument. Two developed arguments beat four bare ones.
why.kk: Түсіндірмесі мен мысалы жоқ тезис — дәлел емес, тізім. Төрт жалаң дәлелден дамытылған екі дәлел жақсы.
why.ru: Тезис без объяснения и примера — список, а не довод. Лучше два развитых довода, чем четыре голых.

options: Adverts for sugary snacks and fast food contribute to poor eating habits.
Adverts are bad for children. They are unfair. They cause problems in families.

why.en: “Discuss both views and give your own opinion” makes an opinion compulsory. Without it Task Response drops.
why.kk: «Discuss both views and give your own opinion» — пікір міндетті. Онсыз Task Response төмендейді.
why.ru: «Discuss both views and give your own opinion» — мнение обязательно. Без него Task Response снижают.

options: This essay will consider both views before arguing that both have a role.
This essay will discuss both views.

why.en: One view, one paragraph. A mixed paragraph reads as chaos and lowers Coherence and Cohesion.
why.kk: Бір көзқарас — бір абзац. Аралас абзац шатасып оқылады, Coherence and Cohesion төмендейді.
why.ru: Одна точка зрения — один абзац. Смешанный абзац читается как хаос и снижает Coherence and Cohesion.

options: Those who believe the state should act point out that poverty is often inherited, not chosen.
Some people think the state should help the poor, but others disagree, and I think personal effort matters, although poverty is often inherited.

why.en: Repetitive openers mean a weak Lexical Resource. Vary them: those who believe, supporters of, critics point out, from this perspective.
why.kk: Бірыңғай кіріспе сөздер — әлсіз Lexical Resource. Ауыстырыңыз: those who believe, supporters of, critics point out, from this perspective.
why.ru: Однообразные вводы — слабый Lexical Resource. Меняйте: those who believe, supporters of, critics point out, from this perspective.

options: Those who believe the state should act point out that… On the other hand, many people argue that…
Some people say that… Other people say that… Some people also say that…

why.en: “Do the advantages outweigh…?” needs a verdict on which side wins. A neutral answer is an incomplete answer.
why.kk: «Do the advantages outweigh…?» не басым екені туралы қорытындыны талап етеді. Бейтарап жауап — толық емес жауап.
why.ru: «Do the advantages outweigh…?» требует вывода, что перевешивает. Нейтральный ответ — неполный ответ.

options: In my view, the benefits of these devices outweigh their drawbacks for most users.
There are both advantages and disadvantages to health apps.

why.en: Both sides are required even if one outweighs the other. Disadvantages go in a separate paragraph.
why.kk: Бір жағы басым болса да, екі жағы да міндетті. Кемшіліктер — бөлек абзацта.
why.ru: Обе стороны обязательны, даже если одна перевешивает. Недостатки — отдельным абзацем.

options: Nevertheless, these technologies have real disadvantages.
Health apps motivate people, detect illness early and help doctors.

why.en: outweigh is a state verb and is not used in the continuous.
why.kk: outweigh — күй етістігі, continuous формасында қолданылмайды.
why.ru: outweigh — глагол состояния, в continuous не используется.

options: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
The advantages are outweighing the disadvantages.

why.en: The questions differ. “What are the advantages and disadvantages?” does not ask for a verdict — covering both sides fully matters more.
why.kk: Тұжырымдар әртүрлі. «What are the advantages and disadvantages?» баға талап етпейді — екі жақты толық ашу маңыздырақ.
why.ru: Формулировки разные. «What are the advantages and disadvantages?» оценки не требует — важнее полно раскрыть обе стороны.

options: In conclusion, digital payments offer speed and security but raise real concerns about privacy.
In my opinion, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. (for “What are the advantages and disadvantages?”)

why.en: Each solution answers a cause you named. A solution “in general” does not count as a developed answer.
why.kk: Әр шешім аталған себепке жауап береді. «Жалпы» шешім дамытылған жауап болып саналмайды.
why.ru: Каждое решение отвечает на названную причину. Решение «вообще» не считается развитым ответом.

options: Governments should help households switch from coal to gas.
The causes are traffic and coal heating. The solution is that people should plant more trees.

why.en: Who does what, exactly. A passive without an agent is an empty sentence.
why.kk: Кім және нақты не істейді. Орындаушысы жоқ ырықсыз етіс — бос сөз.
why.ru: Кто и что конкретно делает. Пассив без исполнителя — пустая фраза.

options: First, governments should help power plants and households switch from coal to gas or electricity.
Pollution should be reduced and the situation must be improved.

why.en: Causes are reasons; problems / effects are consequences. Answer the question that was actually asked.
why.kk: Causes — себептер, problems / effects — салдарлар. Қойылған сұраққа жауап беріңіз.
why.ru: Causes — причины, problems / effects — последствия. Отвечайте на тот вопрос, который задан.

options: The main problem is that long-term exposure to polluted air damages people’s health.
The main cause is road traffic. (for “What problems does this cause?”)

why.en: Two questions need two answers, both visible in the introduction and the conclusion. A missed question keeps Task Response at 5 or below.
why.kk: Екі сұрақ — екі жауап, екеуі де кіріспе мен қорытындыда көрінеді. Жауапсыз қалған сұрақ — Task Response 5-тен аспайды.
why.ru: Два вопроса — два ответа, и оба видны во вступлении и в выводе. Пропущенный вопрос — Task Response не выше 5.

options: Although this brings speed and diversity, the loss of accuracy and shared understanding makes it a negative trend overall.
In conclusion, people use social media for news because it is fast and free.

why.en: “Is this positive or negative?” — choose a side, with a condition if you like.
why.kk: «Is this positive or negative?» — бір жақты таңдаңыз, ескертпемен болса да.
why.ru: «Is this positive or negative?» — выберите сторону, можно с оговоркой.

options: Its overall effect on public understanding is negative.
This development has good and bad sides.

why.en: Do not repeat the question in your text — answer straight away. Words copied from the task do not count.
why.kk: Сұрақты мәтінде қайталамаңыз — бірден жауап беріңіз. Тапсырма сөздері көлемге есептелмейді.
why.ru: Не повторяйте вопрос в тексте — сразу ответ. Слова задания не засчитываются в объём.

options: The main reason is convenience.
Why is this happening? This is happening because people like social media.
